So we have to start/stop/start every timed event we do each night. 10+ events. It’s fine but pretty annoying. 

One feature request is to add more options for sounds at the start, halfway and end. Most are not loud enough to hear in a large room even with speaker on max volume. 

I would like to play music at the end of a timer only. No other app does this. I can do it by faking a “round” break and putting music to the break. So it works, it’s just clearly a bit of an odd workaround when you could have a differentiated feature. 

Otherwise, great app! I’ll happily adjust my rating when the bug is fixed.

When I open up my app on my watch, my interval folders are completely blank even though my phone is showing all my intervals, regardless of how often I sync to my watch. I’ve chosen to not save my workouts on my device, but my watch keeps saving them at the end of every workout and it stalls the app, making it impossible to move onto another interval without quitting the application. 

I used this app for my job as a fitness instructor. We move quickly, and can’t spend time troubleshooting these apps on multiple devices. Please fix these glitches as this is incredibly disappointing and should not be this difficult to navigate and use.
